en: Added a Send button to each queued message. It attempts immediate steering when supported; otherwise the message remains queued. In-flight sends are protected against duplicate clicks, cancellation and automatic replay after an uncertain delivery.
Organized the sidebar into collapsible Pinned, Projects and Recent sections. Project folders expand individually, custom sections remain available, and collapse preferences survive reopening.
zh: 为每条待发送消息补上“发送”按钮。支持实时引导时立即提交，否则保留排队；发送过程中防止重复点击、取消及结果不明确时自动重发。
侧栏改为可折叠的“置顶、项目、最近”分区，项目文件夹可单独展开，保留自定义分区，并记住折叠状态。
